import { secp256k1 } from '@noble/curves/secp256k1.js';
import { keccak_256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha3.js';
import { bytesToHex, concatBytes, hexToBytes, utf8ToBytes } from '@noble/hashes/utils.js';
import { SigningError } from './errors.js';
import { canonicalize, parseStrictJson } from './json.js';
import { signerPublicKeyHex } from './sign.js';
/** Domain separation prefix for merchant profile signatures (ADR-0002 invoice-signing key, distinct domain). */
export const MERCHANT_PROFILE_DOMAIN = 'GhostPay.MerchantProfile.v1\0';
/** Maximum profile size in UTF-8 bytes (spec 14). */
export const MAX_PROFILE_BYTES = 8192;
const HEX_SIG = /^[0-9a-f]{128}$/;
const SIGNER = /^0[23][0-9a-f]{64}$/;
// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
const FORBIDDEN = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u00ad\u061c\u180e\u200b-\u200f\u2028-\u202e\u2060\u2066-\u2069\ufeff\u{e0000}-\u{e007f}]/u;
const B32 = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz234567';
/** merchantId: lowercase base32 (no padding) of the first 10 bytes of keccak256(compressed signer key). 16 chars. */
export function merchantIdFor(signerHex) {
    const h = keccak_256(hexToBytes(signerHex)).subarray(0, 10);
    let bits = 0;
    let acc = 0;
    let out = '';
    for (const b of h) {
        acc = (acc << 8) | b;
        bits += 8;
        while (bits >= 5) {
            out += B32[(acc >>> (bits - 5)) & 31];
            bits -= 5;
        }
        acc &= 0xff;
    }
    return out;
}
function profileDigest(body) {
    return keccak_256(concatBytes(utf8ToBytes(MERCHANT_PROFILE_DOMAIN), utf8ToBytes(canonicalize(body))));
}
function isRec(v) {
    return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
}
function exactKeys(o, allowed) {
    return Object.keys(o).every((k) => allowed.includes(k));
}
function int(v, lo, hi) {
    return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(v) && v >= lo && v <= hi;
}
function str(v, re) {
    return typeof v === 'string' && re.test(v);
}
/** Strict, closed-schema parse of body plus sig. Returns undefined on any violation. */
function parseShape(raw) {
    if (!isRec(raw) || !exactKeys(raw, ['v', 'merchantId', 'name', 'signer', 'chains', 'tokens', 'templates', 'origins', 'allowAmount', 'exp', 'sig']))
        return undefined;
    const { v, merchantId, name, signer, chains, tokens, templates, origins, allowAmount, exp, sig } = raw;
    if (v !== 1 || !str(sig, HEX_SIG) || !str(signer, SIGNER) || !int(exp, 1, 4_102_444_800))
        return undefined;
    if (typeof merchantId !== 'string' || merchantId !== merchantIdFor(signer))
        return undefined;
    if (typeof name !== 'string' || name.length < 1 || name.length > 64 || FORBIDDEN.test(name) || name !== name.normalize('NFC') || name !== name.trim())
        return undefined;
    if (!Array.isArray(chains) || chains.length < 1 || chains.length > 8 || !chains.every((c) => int(c, 1, 2 ** 32 - 1)))
        return undefined;
    if (!Array.isArray(tokens) || tokens.length < 1 || tokens.length > 8 || !tokens.every((t) => str(t, /^[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$/)))
        return undefined;
    if (allowAmount !== undefined && typeof allowAmount !== 'boolean')
        return undefined;
    if (!Array.isArray(templates) || templates.length > 16)
        return undefined;
    const ids = new Set();
    const tpls = [];
    for (const t of templates) {
        if (!isRec(t) || !exactKeys(t, ['id', 'amountMinor', 'currency', 'expires']))
            return undefined;
        if (!str(t.id, /^[a-z0-9_-]{1,32}$/) || ids.has(t.id) || !str(t.amountMinor, /^[1-9][0-9]{0,38}$/) || !str(t.currency, /^[A-Z]{3}$/) || !int(t.expires, 60, 604_800))
            return undefined;
        ids.add(t.id);
        tpls.push({ id: t.id, amountMinor: t.amountMinor, currency: t.currency, expires: t.expires });
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(origins) || origins.length < 1 || origins.length > 8)
        return undefined;
    const orgs = [];
    for (const o of origins) {
        if (typeof o !== 'string' || o.length > 200)
            return undefined;
        let u;
        try {
            u = new URL(o);
        }
        catch {
            return undefined;
        }
        const localhost = u.protocol === 'http:' && u.hostname === 'localhost';
        if ((u.protocol !== 'https:' && !localhost) || u.origin !== o || u.username !== '' || u.password !== '')
            return undefined;
        orgs.push(o);
    }
    return {
        v: 1,
        merchantId,
        name,
        signer,
        chains,
        tokens,
        templates: tpls,
        origins: orgs,
        ...(allowAmount === undefined ? {} : { allowAmount }),
        exp,
        sig,
    };
}
/**
 * Signs a merchant profile with the invoice-signing key.
 *
 * @throws {SigningError} If `body.signer` is not the public key of `signingKey`, or the body is malformed.
 * @security Integrity only. Merchant identity requires the payer to pin the signer fingerprint.
 */
export function signMerchantProfile(body, signingKey) {
    if (signerPublicKeyHex(signingKey) !== body.signer)
        throw new SigningError();
    const sig = bytesToHex(secp256k1.sign(profileDigest(body), signingKey, { prehash: false, lowS: true }));
    const out = parseShape({ ...body, sig });
    if (out === undefined)
        throw new SigningError();
    return out;
}
/**
 * Verifies a merchant profile (JSON text or parsed value): size cap, strict closed schema, low-s signature, expiry.
 * Never throws. A valid result means the holder of `signer` signed these exact fields; it does not identify the merchant.
 *
 * @param input JSON text (size-checked in UTF-8 bytes) or an already parsed object.
 * @param nowSec Current finite Unix time in seconds (fractional values allowed). Invalid runtime clocks fail as expired.
 */
export function verifyMerchantProfile(input, nowSec) {
    let raw = input;
    if (typeof input === 'string') {
        if (utf8ToBytes(input).byteLength > MAX_PROFILE_BYTES)
            return { ok: false, reason: 'size' };
        try {
            raw = parseStrictJson(input);
        }
        catch {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'format' };
        }
    }
    let p;
    try {
        p = parseShape(raw);
    }
    catch {
        p = undefined;
    }
    if (p === undefined)
        return { ok: false, reason: 'format' };
    let valid;
    try {
        const { sig, ...body } = p;
        valid = secp256k1.verify(hexToBytes(sig), profileDigest(body), hexToBytes(p.signer), { prehash: false, lowS: true });
    }
    catch {
        return { ok: false, reason: 'signature' };
    }
    if (!valid)
        return { ok: false, reason: 'signature' };
    if (!Number.isFinite(nowSec) || p.exp <= nowSec)
        return { ok: false, reason: 'expired' };
    return { ok: true, profile: p };
}
